new_claims.statement: For disjoint original banks and R=F(X_I)+G(X_J)+2 sigma (u^T X_I)(v^T X_J), arbitrary same-bank measurable F,G, kappa=|sigma|||u||||v||, sup_s P(|R-s|<=eps)<=min(1,8 sqrt(2 pi eps/kappa)).
For every 0<beta<1/2, H_beta(R)<=C_beta kappa^-beta with C_beta=(2pi)^beta/[Gamma(beta)cos(pi beta/2)beta(1-2beta)]; at beta=1/4 the constant is 3.781277348735447.

The beta=1/2 analogue is false under arbitrary same-bank quadratic curvature: for independent cap-one Y,Z uniform on [-1/2,1/2], -Y^2-Z^2+2YZ=-(Y-Z)^2 and E|R|^-1/2=infinity. This is not a full-target counterexample.

partner_result_applied.actual_application: On its exact-W2 family Q_cond=x0^2+2xy+(w dot Y)^2, the natural rank-one residual has kappa=1, so this run gives small-ball <=min(1,20.0530261971 sqrt(eps)) and H_1/4<=3.781277348735447; the partner re-cut has Delta=1/2 and yields the full density bound 8*2^(1/4)=9.513656920021768.

next_step: Use the newest partner localization of Zeta_3=0 to at-most-two literal transverse coordinates and route those finite-leak critical-sign cases through a bounded-dimensional physical-pair/grouped-square/zero-diagonal receiver; separately retain and pay the nonzero collar 0<s2<1/256 without deleting it.
scope_notes: The new results prove concentration and subcritical fractional potentials, not a full density theorem. The phase-aligned pointwise Fresnel counterexample remains valid. No continuity claim for the new rank-one theorem.
